r1.summary: A landmark 24 hours in artificial intelligence: OpenAI previewed its next-generation reasoning model, Google DeepMind published breakthrough research on autonomous agents, and the EU finalised implementation guidelines for the AI Act affecting enterprise deployments across all 27 member states.

sections.title: Top Stories
items: OpenAI previewed GPT-5 Turbo with a 10× improvement on complex reasoning benchmarks — general availability expected Q3 2026.
Google DeepMind's 'Project Astra' paper demonstrates real-time multimodal reasoning across 12 concurrent tasks with < 200ms latency.
Anthropic raised $3.5B Series F at a $61B valuation; funds earmarked for compute infrastructure expansion.
EU AI Act implementation guidelines published — enterprises have 18 months to achieve compliance for high-risk AI systems.

sections.title: Research Papers
items: "Scaling Laws for Agent Memory" (arXiv 2026.05981) — memory-augmented LLMs outperform base models by 34% on long-horizon tasks.
"MoE-Attention: Sparse Attention Routing in Mixture-of-Experts" (arXiv 2026.05820) — 2.4× inference speedup with 98.7% quality retention.
Stanford HAI 'AI Index 2026' released — global AI investment reached $412B in 2025, up 67% year-over-year.

sections.title: Product Launches
items: Mistral AI released Mistral Large 3 with 128K context and native tool-use, available via API and self-hosted.
Perplexity launched 'Deep Research Pro' featuring automated multi-step web research and citation tracking.
Microsoft Copilot Studio added Agent Orchestration — connect multiple specialised agents into a single workflow.
Meta open-sourced LLaMA 4.1 Scout — 17B parameters, claimed GPT-4o parity on code and reasoning tasks.

sections.title: Regulatory & Policy
items: US Senate passed the 'Responsible AI Deployment Act' requiring watermarking of all AI-generated content.
UK AI Safety Institute published updated red-teaming guidelines for frontier model evaluations.
China's MIIT issued new requirements for AI-generated content labelling, effective July 1, 2026.

pastBriefings.preview: Meta released LLaMA 4.1 Scout open-source. EU AI Act compliance deadlines clarified for SMEs. Perplexity raised $500M at $14B valuation.
Anthropic published Constitutional AI v2 safety research. OpenAI reduced API pricing by 40% across all models.
Google I/O keynote: Gemini 2.5 Ultra announced with 2M token context window and native video understanding.
Microsoft Build: Copilot+ PC lineup expanded. Azure AI Foundry GA. Phi-4 small model released as open-source.

r2.summary: US equities closed higher led by tech and energy sectors. Federal Reserve minutes reinforced a rate hold position. Strong non-farm payrolls data suggests continued economic resilience heading into Q3.

sections.title: Market Summary
items: 10-year Treasury yield 4.41%, down 3bps on Fed hold expectations.
WTI crude oil $73.40/bbl (+1.2%) on OPEC+ production discipline signals.
USD/EUR 1.0812, stable ahead of ECB meeting Thursday.

sections.title: Key Events
items: Fed May minutes: all members favoured holding rates; 2 members raised possibility of 1 cut in H2 2026.
US May jobs report: +187K non-farm payrolls, unemployment 3.9%, wages +3.8% YoY — above consensus.
Nvidia Q1 2027 earnings: revenue $36.4B (+112% YoY), data centre segment +143%, EPS $0.96 vs $0.88 estimated.
Apple announced $110B share buyback programme, largest in company history. Shares +2.1% after-hours.

sections.title: Watchlist
items: ECB rate decision Thursday — consensus expects hold at 3.25%, watch Lagarde press conference.
US CPI print Friday — estimate 3.1% YoY, any upside surprise would pressure equities.
Q2 earnings season begins mid-July — JPMorgan, Wells Fargo, Delta, PepsiCo in first wave.

pastBriefings.preview: Mixed session as core PCE came in slightly above estimates at 3.3%. Tech pulled back 0.4%, energy outperformed.
Consumer confidence beat: 106.2 vs 103.0 expected. Gold hit 6-month high at $2,340/oz. Dollar weakened.

r3.summary: A critical authentication bypass vulnerability in OpenLDAP (CVE-2026-22847, CVSS 9.8) was disclosed and patched. Active exploitation campaigns targeting unpatched systems were observed within 48 hours. Volt Typhoon expanded targeting scope to European critical infrastructure.

sections.title: Critical Vulnerabilities
items: CVE-2026-22847 (CVSS 9.8): OpenLDAP authentication bypass — patch to 2.6.9 immediately, active exploitation confirmed.
CVE-2026-21903 (CVSS 8.1): Remote code execution in Ivanti Connect Secure VPN — CISA emergency directive issued.
CVE-2026-20441 (CVSS 7.5): Linux kernel privilege escalation (6.7–6.9) — fixed in 6.9.4, update distributions.

sections.title: Threat Campaigns
items: APT-41 linked group 'Volt Typhoon' expanded targeting to European energy grid and water treatment operators.
New ransomware variant 'LockBit 4' observed in the wild with improved EDR evasion — 3 confirmed enterprise victims.
Phishing campaign mimicking Microsoft 365 MFA prompts targeting C-suite at financial institutions — 40+ organisations hit.

sections.title: Patches & Mitigations
items: Microsoft released out-of-band patch for Exchange Server SSRF vulnerability — apply immediately, no reboot required.
Cisco issued advisory for IOS XE web UI vulnerability (CVE-2026-20328) — disable HTTP server interface if patching delayed.
CISA updated KEV catalogue with 4 new entries — federal agencies have 21 days to remediate.

pastBriefings.preview: Patch Tuesday: 47 CVEs addressed by Microsoft, 6 rated Critical. Exchange zero-day confirmed exploited in the wild.

r4.summary: SpaceX Starship IFT-4 achieved full mission success with both booster and ship recovered. NASA revised the Artemis III crewed lunar landing to November 2027 pending HLS Starship certification.

sections.title: Mission Updates
items: SpaceX Starship IFT-4: Booster 12 caught by Mechazilla tower arms — first time in history. Ship 28 splashed down precisely in Indian Ocean.
NASA Artemis III crewed lunar landing now targeting November 2027, revised from mid-2026 following HLS Starship certification delays.
ESA Hera mission completed Mars gravity assist — now on final trajectory to Didymos-Dimorphos binary asteroid system, ETA 2026 Q4.

sections.title: Upcoming Launches
items: Rocket Lab Neutron medium-lift vehicle: first launch targeted June 2026 from Wallops Island, VA.
ULA Vulcan Centaur VC2S: second flight carrying Amazon Kuiper broadband satellites scheduled late June.
ISRO Gaganyaan crewed mission: third uncrewed test flight delayed to Q3 2026 following parachute redesign.

pastBriefings.preview: Rocket Lab Electron launched NOAA weather satellite. Blue Origin NS-26 crewed flight completed with 6 passengers.
